title: Happy for you, fr

verse.sanskrit:
उत्सवेषु च सर्वेषु पितेव परितुष्यति ।
सत्यवादी महेष्वासो वृद्धसेवी जितेन्द्रियः ॥
verse.iast:
utsaveṣu ca sarveṣu piteva parituṣyati |
satyavādī maheṣvāso vṛddhasevī jitendriyaḥ ||
verse.translation: At every festival he rejoices like a father. He speaks the truth, is a great archer, serves his elders, and masters his senses.

beats.title: the friend who's HAPPY for you
beats.vo: The citizens of Ayodhya literally listed Rama's green flags. Two of them hit different.
When anyone in the city is going through it, he hurts deeply, like it happened to him.
And at every festival, every celebration, he's happy like a proud dad. Not jealous. Not low key salty. Happy.
At every festival he rejoices like a father. Truthful, a great archer, serves his elders, masters his senses.
Meanwhile us: friend gets the internship. We type congrats, no emoji, and go stare at the ceiling.

beats.title: Their W = your W
beats.vo: Feel their pain like it's yours. Celebrate their win like it's yours. That's the whole vibe.

beats.title: Day 11 of learning from Rama
beats.vo: Day eleven of learning from Rama. Send this to the friend who hypes your wins the loudest.

music_suggestions: An upbeat dhol or festive Bollywood-style track from Instagram's library
Any trending 'so proud of you' audio
caption:
Green flag: the friend who's actually happy for you ✅🎉

When Dasharatha asked the people of Ayodhya about Rama, they said he grieves deeply when anyone is in trouble, and at every festival he rejoices like a father.

“उत्सवेषु च सर्वेषु पितेव परितुष्यति । सत्यवादी महेष्वासो वृद्धसेवी जितेन्द्रियः ॥”
Valmiki Ramayana, Ayodhya Kanda 2.41 (with 2.40)

Their pain, your pain. Their win, your win. Day 11 of learning from Rama.
